definitions.short: something perfect , i.e. a splendid garment
definitions.full: H4360. maklul [ מַכְלֻל ] noun masculine a thing made perfect , i.e. (probably) gorgeous garment (or stuff), Ezek 27:24 וג וְרִקְמָה תְּכֵלֶת בִּגְלֹמֵי בְּמַכְלֻלִים רֹכְלַיִךְ ׳הֵמָּה .
